themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying efforts to implement 'national priority' policies, restricting social benefits and housing to citizens or long-term residents. This theme appears prominently in Spain, Italy, France, Sweden, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Lega, RN, and Reform UK leading the charge. The policies often target immigrants and are framed as protecting national resources.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposing 'national priority' in housing laws in Aragon and Andalusia, restricting benefits to Spanish citizens.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and FdI supporting 'national priority' in social aid and housing policies in regional governments.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocating for 'national preference' in social benefits and housing, aligning with far-right rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushing for stricter residency requirements for social benefits and housing access.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposing policies to prioritize UK citizens in social housing and welfare benefits.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei's approval ratings continue to decline as internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza, escalate. The theme is marked by public disputes with allies, corruption scandals involving close aides, and growing dissatisfaction with his economic policies. This pattern resonates with right-wing movements in the US, Italy, and Spain, where similar internal divisions have emerged.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant gains in local and regional elections across Europe, particularly in Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden. These gains reflect a broader trend of increasing far-right influence in local governance, often through coalition agreements with center-right parties. The theme highlights the growing normalization of far-right policies at the municipal and regional levels.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD makes gains in local elections, particularly in Saxony and Bavaria, often through coalition talks.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and FdI secure victories in municipal elections, often forming coalitions with center-right parties.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox gains influence in regional governments, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla y León, through coalition deals.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD gains in local elections, influencing municipal policies on immigration and welfare.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing significant internal divisions, with factions competing for leadership and influence. These divisions often revolve around ideological purity, leadership challenges, and strategic disagreements. The theme is evident in Poland, Hungary, the UK, Italy, and Argentina, where far-right parties are fracturing along ideological and personal lines.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal strife post-election, with factions competing for control and influence.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces internal divisions over leadership and policy directions, with Farage's influence being challenged.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal divisions between Salvini and Zaia, with Vannacci emerging as a potential challenger.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts within LLA, particularly between Milei and Bullrich, over leadership and policy directions.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and movements are increasingly framing their responses to Middle East conflicts through the lens of national security, immigration, and cultural identity. This theme is evident in the US, Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France, where far-right leaders are leveraging conflicts in the Middle East to advance their agendas on immigration, national sovereignty, and anti-Islam rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration's aggressive stance on Iran and Middle East conflicts, framing them as threats to US security.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's alignment with Israel and strong stance against Iran, reflecting far-right foreign policy priorities.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government supports Israel and takes a hardline stance on Middle East conflicts, aligning with far-right rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS frames Middle East conflicts through the lens of national security and immigration, particularly regarding Muslim migrants.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN leverages Middle East conflicts to advance anti-immigration and anti-Islam policies.
